scientific_integrity: Finite theorem proved by a reduction plus two executable independent exhaustive enumerations. Historic source dates use the earliest day-resolved source independently verified in the cited list: arXiv:1010.0133 first appeared on 2010-10-01; the older 2005 report has only a verified month, and its day has not been invented. The classical Mycielski construction predates both. The reported originality is only the precise named-four-colour reconfiguration decomposition and metric, not four-chromaticity, the raw colouring count, cycle winding, or the standard five-colour mixing bound.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the eleven-vertex Grötzsch graph, named colours, and single-site recolouring only. The signed winding is checked exhaustively for apex moves. All exact distances are within connected components. No infinite-family claim or sampling mixing-time claim. Historical priority is qualified: possible equivalent calculation under alternative Hom-complex or quadrangulation terminology. Independent scholarly audit has not been performed.
title: Two winding sectors in the optimal recolouring graph of the Grötzsch graph
